title: A synthetic observed-result method
author: Original local synthetic example
description: Use an observed-result check when a bounded artifact change needs evidence.
rights_note: Original synthetic example. User documents and third-party derived drafts require their own rights review.

core_frameworks.name: Observe before change
core_frameworks.when: A requested output has an uncertain state
core_frameworks.how: Read the actual output, name one confirmed difference, change it, and reopen.
core_frameworks.why: A file name or source edit cannot establish the rendered result.

chapters.title: Observe and verify
chapters.core_idea: Use observed outputs to choose and verify the smallest useful change.

frameworks.name: Observe before change
frameworks.when: A requested output has an uncertain state
frameworks.how: Read the output, change one confirmed difference and recheck.
frameworks.why: Unobserved assumptions can send the fix to the wrong artifact.

mental_models: Treat a proposed explanation as a testable hypothesis.
anti_patterns: Treating the presence of a source file as user-visible success.
chapters.worked_example: A fictional exported page has the wrong title. Read the export, change that title and reopen it; describe the observed result.
takeaways: Check the actual requested end state.

patterns.name: One confirmed difference
patterns.when: Observed output differs from the request
patterns.how: Correct that discrepancy and inspect the result
patterns.tradeoffs: Larger problems may need another observed iteration.

decision_rules: When evidence is missing, inspect the actual result before editing.
limitations: This is an original synthetic fixture, not a claim about a real source book.
